# curl.se

> > The official home of curl and libcurl, the open-source command-line tool and C library for transferring data with URLs supporting HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, FTPS, MQTT, WebSocket, and 30+ other protocols.

curl is maintained by Daniel Stenberg and the open-source community. The site provides downloads, comprehensive documentation, API references, commercial support options, and community resources for both the curl command-line tool and the libcurl C library used in countless applications worldwide.

## Key Topics

- curl command-line tool
- libcurl C library
- HTTP/HTTPS protocols
- SSL/TLS certificates
- data transfer
- API reference
- easy interface
- multi interface
- WebSocket support
- open-source
- FTP/FTPS
- MQTT protocol
- CA certificates
- Windows builds
- GitHub repository

## Getting Started

- [curl](https://curl.se): Homepage for curl & libcurl data transfer tools supporting 35+ protocols
- [curl - Download](https://curl.se/download.html): Download curl releases, source archives, PGP signatures & changelogs
- [curl for Windows](https://curl.se/windows): Official curl & libcurl Windows builds with mingw, PGP/minisign verified
- [curl - Source Code](https://curl.se/dev/source.html): Access curl source code via git repository on GitHub with build info

## Documentation & Tutorials

- [Everything curl](https://curl.se/book.html): Free comprehensive book on curl & libcurl by Daniel Stenberg
- [curl - Tutorial](https://curl.se/docs/tutorial.html): Beginner tutorial for curl: HTTP, FTP, SSL examples & basic usage guide
- [libcurl - programming tutorial](https://curl.se/libcurl/c/libcurl-tutorial.html): Programming tutorial for libcurl C API: easy & multi interfaces guide
- [curl - The Art Of Scripting HTTP Requests Using curl](https://curl.se/docs/httpscripting.html): HTTP scripting guide: automating web requests with curl command-line

## API Reference

- [libcurl - API](https://curl.se/libcurl/c): libcurl C API overview: easy, multi, share, URL & WebSocket interfaces

## SSL/TLS & Security

- [curl - SSL CA Certificates](https://curl.se/docs/sslcerts.html): Guide to SSL/TLS CA certificate verification with Schannel, SecTrust & more
- [curl - Extract CA Certs from Mozilla](https://curl.se/docs/caextract.html): Extract Mozilla CA certificates to PEM format (cacert.pem bundle)

## Community & Support

- [curl - Mailing lists](https://curl.se/mail): curl mailing lists: curl-library, curl-users for community support
- [curl - Commercial Support](https://curl.se/support.html): Commercial support options for curl/libcurl from wolfSSL & Daniel Stenberg

## Optional

- [curl - Project status dashboard](https://curl.se/dashboard.html): curl project metrics: development stats, author activity & code analytics
- [curl - About curl website](https://curl.se/about.html): About curl.se website: tech stack, Fastly CDN, zero tracking policy
- [Curl: about TLS session resumption with openssl](https://curl.se/mail/lib-2016-11/0032.html): Mailing list archive: TLS session resumption with OpenSSL discussion
